tutorials.title: Find a pharmacy
tutorials.summary: Use Nearby to see pharmacies near your town.

steps.title: Open Nearby
steps.body: Tap Nearby on the bottom bar.
steps.picture: Bottom bar. Nearby is the first button.

steps.title: Check the town
steps.body: The town chip shows where the list is looking. You can save a town in Settings.
steps.picture: A town chip at the top of Nearby, such as New Brunswick.

steps.title: Choose Pharmacy
steps.body: Tap Pharmacy. Call or get directions from the card.
steps.picture: A pharmacy card with Call and Directions.

tutorials.title: Add an appointment
tutorials.summary: Save a visit on this phone so you can see it later.

steps.title: Open My Health
steps.body: Tap My Health on the bottom bar.
steps.picture: Bottom bar. My Health is the second button.

steps.title: Tap Add
steps.picture: Appointments card with an Add button.

steps.title: Save the visit
steps.body: Type the provider, time, and place. Then save. It stays on this phone.
steps.picture: A form with provider, time, and place fields.

tutorials.title: Add a medication
tutorials.summary: Keep your medication list on this phone.

steps.title: Tap Add under Medications
steps.body: Add the name, what it is for, and when you take it.
steps.picture: Medications card with an Add button.

tutorials.title: Use Help Now
tutorials.summary: Help Now is in the top corner on every screen.

steps.title: Tap Help Now
steps.body: Help Now is never locked behind a PIN.
steps.picture: Help Now button in the top bar.

steps.title: 911 is first
steps.body: For police, fire, or a medical emergency, tap 911 Emergency.
steps.picture: A tall black 911 button at the top of the list.
